# CREED Criteria

```{r}
#| label: setup-si-creed
#| include: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# Lets this section render on its own (`quarto render _08-SI02-CREED.qmd`).
# When spliced into index.qmd via {{< include >}}, index.qmd's own `setup`
# chunk has already loaded these; re-running library() is harmless.
library(here)
library(yaml)
library(tidyverse)
library(flextable)

# Identical to the helper in index.qmd's setup chunk. Change one, change both
# (or promote it to an R/ function).
docx_flex <- function(ft, widths = NULL) {
  ft <- ft |>
    flextable::theme_vanilla() |>
    flextable::bold(part = "header") |>
    flextable::fontsize(size = 9, part = "all") |>
    flextable::padding(padding = 2, part = "all")
  if (is.null(widths)) {
    flextable::set_table_properties(ft, layout = "autofit", width = 1)
  } else {
    flextable::set_table_properties(
      flextable::width(ft, width = widths),
      layout = "fixed"
    )
  }
}

creed <- yaml::read_yaml(here::here(
  "data/clean/lookups/CREED_Copper_Purpose.yml"
))
```

As part of data extraction from each study, a CREED assessment was performed [@dipaoloImplementationCREEDApproach2024]. Each CREED assessment consists (in part) of a battery of Reliability (generic) and Relevance (study-specific) criteria. Studies are assessed for their relevance against a purpose statement. The purpose statement used for CREED evaluation in this study is reproduced below (@tbl-creed-relevance).

> `r creed$study_purpose`

::: landscape

```{r}
#| label: tbl-creed-relevance
#| tbl-cap: "Criteria for Reporting and Evaluating Exposure Datasets relevance criteria for evaluated studies."
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

fmt_requirements <- function(reqs) {
  if (is.null(reqs) || length(reqs) == 0) {
    return("")
  }
  paste0("• ", unlist(reqs), collapse = "\n")
}

fmt_level <- function(level) {
  parts <- c(
    level$description,
    fmt_requirements(level$requirements),
    if (!is.null(level$notes)) paste0("Note: ", trimws(level$notes))
  )
  paste(parts[nzchar(parts)], collapse = "\n")
}

purrr::map_dfr(creed$criteria, function(x) {
  tibble::tibble(
    ID = x$id,
    Criterion = sub(paste0("^", x$id, ":\\s*"), "", x$name),
    `Partly met` = fmt_level(x$partly_met),
    `Fully met` = fmt_level(x$fully_met)
  )
}) |>
  flextable::flextable() |>
  flextable::valign(valign = "top", part = "body") |>
  docx_flex(widths = c(0.55, 1.95, 2.6, 2.6))
```

:::
